title: A sharp stationary moment threshold away from equality for Boolean Doob chains with two bases
abstract: For Boolean noise of correlation one half, consider reversible Doob transforms whose stationary law factors through a binary linear quotient admitting two disjoint column bases. For every fixed moment order from two up to but excluding 15/7, we construct chains with exact stationary marginal matching through a linear fraction of the coordinates, exponential convergence of the density to one in that moment norm, and an exponentially small spectral gap. A Hamming sphere traps the chain, and a multiplicative correction to its edge law makes the matching exact. Together with the prior sufficient criterion above 15/7 this identifies the threshold away from equality. At the second moment, a uniformly bounded inverse stationary moment of order above 35/9 suffices for ordered spectral recovery at arbitrary rank.
